title: Lifestyle Vlog Day-in-Life Thumbnail
prompt_text: Create a 1280×720 YouTube thumbnail for a lifestyle vlog. Subject: [the person in the photo] center-frame with warm genuine smile, casual outfit. Background: golden-hour soft-focus city street or cozy bedroom, warm bokeh lights. Bold sans-serif overlay text reads "A DAY IN MY LIFE" in cream-white with subtle drop shadow, top-right placement. Aesthetic: aspirational lifestyle, IG-grid friendly, warm color grade.

title: Travel Vlog Adventure Thumbnail
prompt_text: Create a 1280×720 YouTube travel vlog thumbnail. Subject: [the person in the photo] left-half, confident expression, outdoor travel outfit, slight wind in hair. Background: stunning landscape (mountain / ocean / city skyline) with golden-hour lighting. Right-half overlay: bold sans-serif title "[DESTINATION]: I CAN'T BELIEVE THIS!" in white with thick black stroke. High contrast, sharp focus, premium travel YouTuber aesthetic.

title: Vertical Shorts Hook Thumbnail
prompt_text: Create a 1080×1920 vertical YouTube Shorts thumbnail. Subject: [the person in the photo] full-body or 3/4 portrait, exaggerated shocked expression. Background: bold gradient (red→orange or purple→pink), motion lines radiating outward, slight glow. Top overlay: huge bold text "WAIT, WHAT?!" in yellow with thick black stroke. Bottom: small icon hint at content (e.g., dollar sign, brain, ⚡). Vertical clickbait composition, sharp focus.
